content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Any Degree with Diploma in Sports Coaching (Football) from any of the SAI NS NIS Center; OR 4 Year B.Sc. Sports Coaching from National Sports University; And A or B or C License in Coaching from Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Experience: Preference: Minimum 3 years' experience in coaching field (football) Other conditions: Entry Permit is required for non-residents of Lakshadweep for visiting and residing at Lakshadweep The Department will not arrange entry permit for interview purpose Desirable: Minimum 3 years' experience in coaching field (football) Communication Skill in Malayalam

content_sections.heading: How Will Directorate of Sports & Youth Affairs, Lakshadweep Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Academic Merit (50 to 70 marks by percentage band) Experience as coach in any Football Academy for a minimum period of 3 years (2 marks) Merit of team conducted by AIFF (5 marks) Communication Skill (5 marks) Interview (18 marks) Academic Merit: 50%-60% = 50 marks, 61%-70% = 55, 71%-80% = 60, 81%-90% = 65, 91%-100% = 70 marks Interview: 18 marks; online / offline on 5.12.2026 at 11 am Link for the online interview will be communicated to the applicants

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Directorate of Sports & Youth Affairs, Lakshadweep Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Directorate of Sports & Youth Affairs, Lakshadweep Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Football Coach.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Directorate of Sports & Youth Affairs, Lakshadweep Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 25 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.75,000 monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Any Degree with Diploma in Sports Coaching (Football) from any of the SAI NS NIS Center OR 4 Year B.Sc. Sports Coaching from National Sports University, AND A or B or C License in Coaching from Asian Football Confederation (AFC).

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Entry Permit is required for non-residents of Lakshadweep for visiting and residing at Lakshadweep. The Department will not arrange entry permit for interview purpose.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Academic Merit (50 to 70 marks by percentage band). Experience as coach in any Football Academy for a minimum period of 3 years (2 marks). Merit of team conducted by AIFF (5 marks). Communication Skill (5 marks).

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on contract basis up to 22.04.2027, which is likely to be extended.

faq.answer: Lakshadweep Football Academy, U.T of Lakshadweep.
